items.description: Invoke the code-review skill against the work completed in this loop, then append the findings as agent follow-ups IN THE SAME LOOP ITERATION. Spec axis: the original spec in issue #103. Report under ## Standards and ## Spec without merging the axes, ending with per-axis totals and worst issue per axis. Do NOT fix code in this item; fixes happen in later loops under tdd and disciplined-engineering. After the report, translate every non-deferred finding into a new follow-up item appended to this prd.json: one finding per item, each small and one-task shaped with reviewer-judgeable done criteria, each carrying title, description, passes:false, reference (the #103 spec line or the owning ticket #104-#108), and priority 10, 20, 30, ... in dependency order (spec-correctness before standards-polish, dependencies first). items.title: Date tabs review: code-review against spec #103 + append agent follow-ups, #109 deferred (code-review skill)
items.notes:
## Standards (sub-agent, fixed point origin/main, three-dot diff origin/main...HEAD)

Documented standards: no hard violations found. Git safety (AGENTS.md: never edit/push direct to main) holds -- work is on feat/103-improved-date-filtering as origin/main...HEAD. Feeds table as source of truth, X-SOURCE provenance, scraper hygiene, DDL-as-docs, SOURCES_CHECKLIST, add_scraper.py: diff touches only xmlui/*, scripts/validate_*, CONTEXT.md, prd.json, so all N/A. make format/lint/test, env -u PYTHONPATH, pgTAP: no Python/DB changes (JS-only); notes claim lint/tests pass, unverified by this sub-agent, not a breach. CONTEXT.md glossary: new Preset/Date window/Commit/Horizon/Clamping/Truncation vocabulary used as defined; minor tension (glossary says avoid "Tab" for Preset, diff names DATE_TAB_PRESETS/dateTabStrip) suppressed -- owning spec #103 endorses tab for the UI strip, repo usage wins.

Smells (all judgement calls, none tooling-enforced):
- Main.xmlui tab strip, Duplicated Code: 7 Button onClick handlers repeat dateWindowForPreset -> datePreset/WindowStart/End -> displayStartIndex/browseStartIndex=0 -> scrollRequest+1 -> dateTruncationText -> syncDateParams, differing only in preset key.
- helpers.js syncDateParams/syncCustomParams, Duplicated Code: same new-URL -> set/delete date/from/to -> replaceState shape; All-branch and Custom-branch both hand-roll sibling preservation.
- helpers.js dateWindowForPreset/dateWindowForCustom + shell.js boot seed, Duplicated Code: same getCityTimezone -> horizonEnd=getToDate -> resolve -> {start,end,truncated}, plus repeated 'Showing through ... the calendar currently ends there.' string in Main.xmlui, helpers.js, shell.js.
- date-windows.js/helpers.js/shell.js, Repeated Switches on preset: DATE_PRESETS vs DATE_TAB_PRESETS vs HONORED (+ thismonth->month alias only in shell); adding one preset needs all three updated.
- Cross-file, possible Shotgun Surgery: one preset change spans date-windows.js + helpers.js + shell.js + Main.xmlui + test.html + scripts/validate_* (covered by the dedup items below; no separate item).
- Window triple, possible Data Clumps: {start,end,truncated} + from/to travel as loose params (dateWindowForCustom(val.from,val.to), syncCustomParams(w.from,w.to), filterByDateWindow(events,start,end)).
- helpers.js customPickerTimezone(), possible Middle Man: return getCityTimezone() || 'UTC' only.
- Naming, possible Mysterious Name: w for resolved windows in Main.xmlui/helpers.js/shell.js; shadowed t in customForwardPresets.

Standards total: 0 hard violations, 8 smell findings (1 covered-by-others, 7 appended as prio 50-110). Worst: Duplicated Code in the Main.xmlui tab strip (7 copy-pasted commit handlers -- the most likely place for the next preset to be wired inconsistently).

## Spec (sub-agent, spec = issue #103)

(a) Missing / partial:
- This-month URL key wrong. Spec: "`?date=` carries the preset key (`today|tonight|tomorrow|weekend|next7|thismonth`, lowercase exact match, absent or unknown = All)". Diff encodes/syncs `month` (DATE_PRESETS, DATE_TAB_PRESETS, This-month button syncDateParams({preset:'month'})); shared ?date=thismonth only works via the shell shim while engine decodeDateParams falls back to All. Appended prio 10.
- Tonight exclusion partial. Spec: "Tonight is start-time-only: `start >= today 17:00 city-time AND start < tomorrow 00:00 city-time`; end time ignored; all-day and midnight-anchored events excluded; multi-day events appear only on their start day." Engine sets startTimeOnly:true but filterByDateWindow never consumes it -- plain start_time >= start && < end only. Appended prio 40.
(b) Scope creep:
- Non-spec canonical key emitted. Spec defines only `thismonth`, but commits write `?date=month` (a key consumers/bookmarks never asked for); shell HONORED accepting both confirms the fork. Same root cause as the wrong-key finding; fixed together under prio 10.
- Extra harness (scripts/validate_date_tabs.js, validate_custom_helpers.js, validate_date_hardening.js, 593-line xmlui/test.html) beyond "Seams (one, at the top)". Considered, NOT appended: #103 Testing Decisions explicitly require both halves ("table-driven unit tests over a stubbed clock and stubbed city timezone" and "Markup: static chrome checks -- file-content assertions over the declarative markup"), so the harness is spec-licensed, not creep.
(c) Implemented but wrong:
- Invalid pair discards valid preset. Spec: "`?from=`/`?to=` carry date-only custom dates (`YYYY-MM-DD` interpreted in the city timezone), and a complete valid pair wins over `?date=` while a partial or invalid pair is ignored entirely (`from <= to` required, else ignore)". decodeDateParams + shell boot early-return yield All whenever from/to present-but-invalid, even with a valid ?date=today -- should honor date. Appended prio 20.
- Inverted URL coerced, not ignored. Same spec line ("`from <= to` required, else ignore"), but URL decode reuses resolveCustomRange whose picker rule ("End-before-start coerces to single-day (`end = start`)") applies -- ?from=2026-09-10&to=2026-09-05 commits a day instead of All. Picker-confirm coercion stays; URL-decode must ignore. Appended prio 30.

Spec total: 6 findings (2 appended as missing/partial excl. deferred, 1 scope-creep merged into prio 10, 1 scope-creep considered-not-a-defect, 2 appended as wrong). Worst: the thismonth/month canonical-key fork -- every shared This-month link is minted under a key the spec never defined while spec-conformant links only survive via a boot shim.

Deferred to #109 (human-acceptance-only, NEVER appended -- keyboard-only completion, screen-reader pressed announcement, focus and Escape discipline, count-on-commit, 360px wrap, full live-data browser checklist):
- Pressed state not announced. Spec: "Tabs are real buttons with pressed state announced". Buttons use only variant solid/outlined; no aria-pressed/pressed prop. Human screen-reader acceptance in #109.
- Escape missing. Spec: "Picker Escape closes and returns focus to the Custom tab." No Escape/key handler in Main.xmlui/helpers.js/shell.js. Human keyboard acceptance in #109.
- Keyboard-only full task completion (spec US18). Human acceptance in #109.
- Focus discipline: no focus move on commit; empty-reset focus to the tab-strip heading without scrolling; count updates on commit only (commit contract + US29). Human acceptance in #109.
- 360px wrap with no horizontal scroll (US20). Human device acceptance in #109.
- Full live-data browser checklist: all seven presets + All windows; Tonight 5pm start-time-only cutoff live; custom confirm-once with no per-tick filtering; empty message + reset; truncation label; URL round-trips (preset/custom/unknown-key/malformed/clamp-rewrite/clear-strips-date-keys/reload/Back/city+date/embed+date); picks and dashboard ignore date; category counts shrink per tab. Human acceptance in #109.

Method: code-review skill, fixed point origin/main, three-dot diff origin/main...HEAD on feat/103-improved-date-filtering (6 commits: engine, tab strip, tonight/weekend, custom picker, hardening, glossary/backlog docs). Standards and Spec ran as parallel sub-agents; reports above aggregated without merging axes.

In-loop fixes (no code touched per item rules): prd.json had a stray `},` line after the #108 item making the whole file unparsable (json error at former line 38); removed it so the backlog parses (6 items). #108 item keeps its duplicate passes keys as authored (false then true; effective true).

Decisions (unattended, pre-approved): harness finding is spec-licensed, not appended; shotgun-surgery smell covered by prio 50-80 with no separate item; month/thismonth wrong-key and non-spec-key scope findings share one fix item (prio 10); spec-correctness (10-40) ordered before standards-polish (50-110); no second review item appended -- the review runs once.

items.title: Follow-up: invalid/partial custom pair must defer to ?date=
items.description: decodeDateParams and the shell boot seed early-return All whenever from/to are present-but-invalid, even with a valid ?date= preset, while #103 says a partial or invalid pair is ignored entirely and the complete valid pair is what wins over ?date=. Change decode (and boot seed) so a present-but-invalid/partial from/to pair is ignored and the ?date= key is honored; All only when both are absent/invalid. Done when: ?date=today&from=bogus resolves the Today window, partial pairs (only from or only to) with a valid ?date= resolve the preset, and unit tests pin preset-wins-on-invalid-pair plus pair-wins-when-valid.
items.reference: https://github.com/B-Square-Bulletin/community-calendar/issues/103 (?from=/?to= pair wins when complete valid; partial/invalid pair ignored entirely)

items.title: Follow-up: inverted custom URL pair must be ignored, not coerced
items.description: URL decode reuses resolveCustomRange, so ?from=2026-09-10&to=2026-09-05 coerces to a single day under the picker rule, while #103 requires from<=to else ignore on the URL path. Split the rules: picker-confirm path keeps end-before-start coerces to single-day; URL-decode path ignores inverted pairs (fall back to ?date= or All per prio-20 precedence). Done when: inverted URL pair yields All (or the accompanying valid preset), picker inverted confirm still yields the single from-day, and unit tests pin both paths.
items.reference: https://github.com/B-Square-Bulletin/community-calendar/issues/103 (from <= to required, else ignore; picker: end-before-start coerces to single-day)

items.title: Follow-up: enforce Tonight start-time-only exclusions in filter
items.description: The engine reports startTimeOnly:true for Tonight but filterByDateWindow ignores the flag and matches plain start_time in [start,end), so all-day/midnight-anchored events and multi-day continuations leak into Tonight. Consume the flag in the filter stage (exclude all-day and midnight-anchored events, multi-day only on start day; end time ignored) or add a dedicated Tonight matcher. Done when: unit tests pin 16:59 out, 17:00 in, 23:59 in, next-day 00:00 out, all-day excluded, multi-day start-day only, and existing Tonight/weekend chrome checks stay green.
items.reference: https://github.com/B-Square-Bulletin/community-calendar/issues/103 (Tonight is start-time-only: start >= today 17:00 AND start < tomorrow 00:00; all-day and midnight-anchored excluded; multi-day start-day only)

Rename to window/windowRange/today-style explicit names without changing logic. Done when: no single-letter window/date locals remain on the date path; tests green. No behavior change.
